resources.string: Tap the card pile. The top card shows a colour.
Your piece hops to the next square with that colour.
A double card hops to the second square of that colour.
Bridges, ladders and ziplines are shortcuts. The Gooey Puddle makes you wait one turn.
First to the Party Table wins. Computers can fill empty seats.
Colour-card trail games need no reading or counting, so even a three-year-old can play.
